title: Wells Fargo’s CEO Says AI Will Erase Tens of Thousands of Jobs. Here’s Why He’s Still Not Worried About Your Wallet
excerpt: Wells Fargo's Charlie Scharf just admitted AI will eliminate tens of thousands of bank jobs, then turned around and called the American consumer stronger tha...
content_html:
Quick Read

  • WFC posted Q2 EPS of $2.00, up 25% year over year, while Scharf warned AI automation will still eliminate tens of thousands of additional positions.

  • Scharf flagged a real macro risk: AI productivity gains hit corporate earnings fast, but worker retraining and new job creation lag dangerously behind.

  • With credit card spend up 10%, debit spend up 7%, and delinquencies falling, Scharf's internal data shows the mass-market consumer still holding firm.

  • Act now: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just named his top 10 AI stocks — and Wells Fargo didn't make the cut. Grab the names FREE today.

Bank CEOs usually talk about AI the way they talk about weather. Something happening, worth mentioning, no need to alarm anyone. Wells Fargo (NYSE:WFC) chief Charlie Scharf went the other way on CNBC's Squawk on the Street this morning, saying automation will eliminate tens of thousands of positions at the bank, then immediately arguing the American consumer is strong enough to absorb the blow. Both halves of that argument matter for anyone holding the stock.

Wells Fargo trades at $88.39 as of this writing, up 14% over the past year and down 7.15% year to date. The market is treating Scharf's comments as management doing exactly what management is supposed to do.

The Job Cut Admission

Scharf did not hedge. "Our headcount since I've been at the company is down 79,000 people. We're down 15,000 over the past year, 7500 over the last quarter. And that has nothing to do with AI. But when we think about the ability to automate roles... it's going to result in tens of thousands of fewer positions."

The distinction matters. The 79,000 jobs already gone were a restructuring story. Wells Fargo has cut headcount for 24 consecutive quarters, ending Q2 2026 at 197,000 employees. The AI wave is a second, separate cut still ahead. Meanwhile, productivity gains are already showing up in the numbers.

Act now: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just named his top 10 AI stocks — and Wells Fargo didn't make the cut. Grab the names FREE today.

Q1 2026 EPS was $1.60 on revenue of $21.446 billion, and Q2 diluted EPS jumped to $2.00, up 25% year over year while headcount fell 7%. Return on tangible common equity hit 17.7%, right at the top of the raised 17-18% medium-term target. Fewer people, more money, higher returns. You can see the strategy in the Q1 2026 8-K without squinting.

The Catch He Was Willing to Name

Then Scharf said the thing most CEOs skip. "I do believe that this is a great thing for the economy, but the time periods might not match up, the skill levels might not match up. And so we all have to work really hard in private industry and with government to figure out how we're going to bridge that gap."

截至撰写本文时，富国银行的交易价格为 88.39 美元，去年上涨 14%，今年迄今下跌 7.15%。 市场将沙夫的言论视为管理层正在做管理层应该做的事情。

裁员入场

沙尔夫没有对冲。 “自从我加入公司以来，我们的员工人数减少了 79,000 人。 去年我们减少了 15,000 人，比上季度减少了 7500 人。 这与人工智能无关。 但当我们考虑角色自动化的能力时...... 这将导致职位减少数以万计。”

区别很重要。 已经消失的 79,000 个工作岗位是一个重组故事。 富国银行已连续 24 个季度裁员，截至 2026 年第二季度员工人数为 197,000 人。 人工智能浪潮是第二次单独的浪潮，仍然遥遥领先。 与此同时，生产率的提高已经体现在数字上。

他愿意说出的捕获物

然后沙夫说了大多数首席执行官都会跳过的话。 “我确实相信这对经济来说是一件好事，但时间段可能不匹配，技能水平可能不匹配。 因此，我们所有人都必须在私营企业并与政府一起努力工作，找出如何弥合这一差距。”
